instrument_name: N.J.S.A. 34:11-4.6 Dissemination of information; records (text as printed by NJ DOL)
authority: NJ Department of Labor and Workforce Development, Wage and Hour (nj.gov/labor)
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer shall: (a) notify employees at hire of pay rate and regular payday; (b) notify of changes before they take effect; (c) furnish each employee a statement of deductions for each pay period deductions are made; employers with 10 or more employees (public employers included) must also show gross wages, net wages, rate of pay and, if relevant to the wage calculation, hours worked; electronic statement allowed unless the employee asks for paper; (d) post an abstract of P.L. 1965 c.173 supplied by the commissioner; (e) keep records. No language clause in the text. Authority's reproduction of the statute, not the Legislature's own site (pub.njleg.gov and lis.njleg.state.nj.us did not connect from this machine).

instrument_name: NM Laws 2005 SB 639 final text: Section 2 amends NMSA 1978 50-4-2 (semimonthly and monthly pay days)
figure_or_rule_carried: Text as passed: B. 'An employer shall provide an employee with a written receipt that identifies the employer and sets forth the employee's gross pay, the number of hours worked by the employee, the total wages and benefits earned by the employee and an itemized listing of all deductions withheld from the employee's gross pay.' Pay days no more than 16 days apart; first-to-15th paid by the 25th, 16th-to-end paid by the 10th of next month. No language clause. Limit: 2005 amendment text; later amendments to 50-4-2 not excluded by this row (see US-NMP8-002).

instrument_name: KRS 337.070 Employer to furnish employee with statement of wage deductions
figure_or_rule_carried: Employers with ten or more employees that make deductions must state each deduction specifically and, at payment, furnish a paper or electronic statement giving the amount of each deduction and its general purpose; if electronic, provide access to a computer and printer. Effective June 29, 2017 (2017 Ky. Acts ch. 134 sec. 5). No language clause.

instrument_name: KRS 337.320 Record to be kept by employer
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer records of amount paid each pay period and hours worked each day and week; kept at least one year after entry; open to the commissioner. No language clause.

instrument_name: KRS 337.325 Posting of summaries of wage and hour laws, orders and regulations
figure_or_rule_carried: Employers subject to KRS 337.275-337.325, 337.345, 337.385-337.405 keep the state-issued wage and hour summaries posted in a conspicuous accessible place; the state furnishes copies free on request. No language clause. The regulations under 803 KAR were not read.

instrument_name: NY DFS Decision on Premium Rate for Paid Family Leave Benefits and Maximum Employee Contribution, coverage beginning 1 Jan 2026
authority: New York State Department of Financial Services
figure_or_rule_carried: Premium rate for 2026 raised +11.31% over 2025. 'The 2026 PFL rate will be set at 0.432% of an employee's wages each pay period up to and not to exceed an annual maximum employee contribution of $411.91'; once the maximum is reached the employee owes no more for that year; employers collect the contributions. CONFIRMS US-NYP7-002 (0.432%, max 411.91) from the authority page itself.
